description: Source code implementing wrapper functions for RWByteAddressBuffer Load/Store operations in HLSL, including load, store, length, and atomic operations for shader storage buffer objects.

classes.name: ShaderStorageBlockFunctionHLSL
classes.description: Class providing static methods to generate shader storage buffer object functions for HLSL, including load, store, length, and atomic operations.

methods.name: OutputSSBOLoadFunctionBody
methods.description: Generates the body of the load function for a shader storage buffer object based on the type and layout.

methods.name: OutputSSBOStoreFunctionBody
methods.description: Generates the body of the store function for a shader storage buffer object based on the type and layout.

methods.name: OutputSSBOLengthFunctionBody
methods.description: Generates the body of the length function for an unsized shader storage buffer object.

methods.name: OutputSSBOAtomicMemoryFunctionBody
methods.description: Generates the body of atomic memory functions (add, min, max, etc.) for shader storage buffer objects.

methods.name: registerShaderStorageBlockFunction
methods.description: Registers a shader storage block function with specific parameters and returns its function name.

methods.name: shaderStorageBlockFunctionHeader
methods.description: Outputs the header and body of all registered shader storage block functions.
